name: מִקְנֵיָהוּ
summary: A Levite of the second rank, one of the singers and gatekeepers David's chiefs of the Levites appointed when the ark was brought up to Jerusalem, who played the lyre “on the Sheminith, to lead” (1Ch 15:16–21). The name is the noun מִקְנֶה “what is acquired, possession” in its construct form, with יָהוּ: “possession of Yahweh”, the people whom Yahweh acquired as his own (Exo 15:16; Psa 74:2). Scripture does not explain it.

evidence.note: Among “their brothers of the second rank … וּמִקְנֵיָהוּ … the gatekeepers”.
With lyres, “on the Sheminith, to lead”.
מִקְנֵה־צֹאן “possessions of flocks”: the construct of the noun, as in the name.
“Your congregation which you acquired of old.”
